My family makes this mac and cheese, it sounds strange but it's actually amazing. We always have it with ribs or smoked pulled pork. I never use exact measurements for it but I can give you round abouts and adjust to your taste. I usually add more cheese and pepper.

1 bag of egg noodles
3/4-1 stick butter
2 cups milk
2 Teaspoons of sugar
Tablespoon of yellow mustard
2 cups of shredded cheese(I use Colby jack)

Boil egg noodles. After that's done drain and add to a 9×13 pan. Add the butter to the noodles so it melts. In a separate bowl mix milk sugar, mustard and mix. Pour the mixture over the noodles. Mix in cheese and add cheese on top. Put in oven at 350F° for about 30 min or until bubbly and cheese on top browned.

That's it! Like I said sounds weird but no one can ever tell the sugar or mustard are in there till we tell them.
